purpose: Bounded noncommercial feasibility of a reproducible bearing-level data and classical-baseline pipeline; no novel filter, superiority, deployment or 1-percent-FPR claim.

source.authors: Christian Lessmeier, James Kuria Kimotho, Detmar Zimmer, Walter Sextro

machine_and_sensor.rig: KAt modular electromechanical drive/bearing test rig, Paderborn University
machine_and_sensor.traceable_calibration_certificates: NOT_AVAILABLE; no absolute metrological accuracy claim
machine_and_sensor.sensor_unit_policy: Preserve native stored numbers and record the MAT channel Unit; do not invent a calibration conversion.

selection.record_rule: Exactly N15_M07_F10_{bearing_id}_1.mat; first 256000 of 256001 samples, omitting final endpoint; nominal half-open 4 seconds; first repeat fixed before score analysis.
selection.channel_rule: Exactly one channel with Name vibration_1; no other channels used.
selection.source_dtype: native numeric converted losslessly to float64; reject non-exact conversion
selection.excluded: 12 artificially machined damage bearings, other settings and repeats; no post-result exclusion.
selection.unit: unspecified_native_amplitude; no SI conversion or absolute calibration claim

ground_truth.basis: Source paper Tables 5 and 6, physical bearing damage characterization from accelerated lifetime tests. Labels are not derived from this pilot score.
limitations: Source-curated laboratory bearings; not a probability sample of an industrial fleet.
One common rig/site; no assertion of statistical independence across machines/sites.
Public data are not a secret or externally protected holdout.

methods.candidate_filter: NONE; no further filter development in this pilot
methods.kurtosis: mean((x-mean(x))^4) / mean((x-mean(x))^2)^2; Pearson, no bias correction

envelope.phase: offline zero-phase sosfiltfilt; no streaming or latency claim
envelope.spectrum: mean-removed envelope, periodic Hann, rFFT squared magnitude
envelope.score: maximum of two harmonic-band power sums divided by total 20..500-Hz power

methods.threshold: For each fixed method: nextafter(max(validation healthy scores), +infinity); no evaluation access for fitting.
methods.method_selection: None after data inspection. Report all three; no winner or new filter chosen.

required: All 20 fixed records, labels, groups and hashes match; no duplicated bearing or identical signal bytes.
All three fixed scores are finite and reproducible.
Thresholds use only two validation healthy bearings; evaluation contains exactly six preselected bearings.
Independent replay matches all counts, decisions and scores; all corruption controls reject.
not_claimed: Causal streaming, energy savings or resource targets
Independent industrial generalization or commercial data rights
